answer: Agents file a reef survey: one reef plot, a 40-credit fee and a 70-credit bond. The survey anchors its agent to one haven mooring; the registry posts an echo of each filing. A second filing within 10 m of another is rejected and its bond burns; no echo-farming ring reuses one survey. Running 1,000 fake filings burns 40,000 in fees and ties up 70,000 in bonds for a 40,000 prize pool; one honest filing costs 40 and the bond comes back.
